summary: Learn to check HR data, calculate workforce measures and present findings in Excel. Explore the five-day human resource data analytics course.
lede: Human resource data analytics helps HR analysts, HR business partners and people operations leads turn workforce records into defensible measures for decisions. Learners practise defining metrics, building a data dictionary, checking records, calculating turnover and time-to-fill, comparing recruitment funnels and cohorts, and presenting findings with context and limits in Excel.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with employee, recruitment or workforce planning data and need to explain what the numbers can support. It suits foundation-level learners who want a repeatable approach to HR measures and analysis.
modules: HR Data Ethics and AI Screening
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with HR processes and spreadsheet use is helpful. No coding or prior statistical analysis is required.
